import Mathlib

def total_weight (selected : List Bool) (weights : List Nat) : Nat :=
  match selected, weights with
  | [], _ => 0
  | _, [] => 0
  | b :: bs, w :: ws => (if b then w else 0) + total_weight bs ws

def total_value (selected : List Bool) (values : List Nat) : Nat :=
  match selected, values with
  | [], _ => 0
  | _, [] => 0
  | b :: bs, v :: vs => (if b then v else 0) + total_value bs vs

def is_valid_strategy (selected : List Bool) (weights : List Nat) (capacity : Nat) : Prop :=
  selected.length = weights.length ∧
  total_weight selected weights ≤ capacity

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def knapsack_01_precond (weights values : List Nat) (capacity : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  weights.length = values.length
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def allBoolLists : Nat → List (List Bool)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | n + 1 =>
    (allBoolLists n).map (fun l => true :: l) ++ (allBoolLists n).map (fun l => false :: l)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def knapsack_01 (weights values : List Nat) (capacity : Nat)
    (h_precond : knapsack_01_precond weights values capacity) : Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  ((allBoolLists weights.length).filter
      (fun s => decide (total_weight s weights ≤ capacity))).foldr
    (fun s acc => max (total_value s values) acc) 0
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def knapsack_01_postcond (weights values : List Nat) (capacity : Nat) (result : Nat)
    (_ : knapsack_01_precond weights values capacity) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (∀ selected, is_valid_strategy selected weights capacity → total_value selected values ≤ result) ∧
  (∃ selected, is_valid_strategy selected weights capacity ∧ total_value selected values = result)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem tw_nil (ws : List Nat) : total_weight [] ws = 0 := by
  cases ws <;> rfl

theorem tw_right_nil (s : List Bool) : total_weight s [] = 0 := by
  cases s <;> rfl

theorem tv_nil (vs : List Nat) : total_value [] vs = 0 := by
  cases vs <;> rfl

theorem tv_right_nil (s : List Bool) : total_value s [] = 0 := by
  cases s <;> rfl

theorem tw_cons (b : Bool) (bs : List Bool) (w : Nat) (ws : List Nat) :
    total_weight (b :: bs) (w :: ws) = (if b then w else 0) + total_weight bs ws := rfl

theorem tv_cons (b : Bool) (bs : List Bool) (v : Nat) (vs : List Nat) :
    total_value (b :: bs) (v :: vs) = (if b then v else 0) + total_value bs vs := rfl

theorem total_weight_replicate_false (n : Nat) (weights : List Nat) :
    total_weight (List.replicate n false) weights = 0 := by
  induction n generalizing weights with
  | zero =>
    rw [List.replicate_zero, tw_nil]
  | succ n ih =>
    cases weights with
    | nil => exact tw_right_nil _
    | cons w ws =>
      rw [List.replicate_succ, tw_cons]
      simp [ih]

theorem total_value_replicate_false (n : Nat) (values : List Nat) :
    total_value (List.replicate n false) values = 0 := by
  induction n generalizing values with
  | zero =>
    rw [List.replicate_zero, tv_nil]
  | succ n ih =>
    cases values with
    | nil => exact tv_right_nil _
    | cons v vs =>
      rw [List.replicate_succ, tv_cons]
      simp [ih]

theorem mem_allBoolLists : ∀ (n : Nat) (l : List Bool), l ∈ allBoolLists n ↔ l.length = n := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro l
    cases l with
    | nil => simp [allBoolLists]
    | cons b t => simp [allBoolLists]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro l
    constructor
    · intro h
      simp only [allBoolLists, List.mem_append, List.mem_map] at h
      rcases h with ⟨a, ha, hEq⟩ | ⟨a, ha, hEq⟩ <;>
        · subst hEq
          simp [(ih a).mp ha]
    · intro h
      cases l with
      | nil => simp at h
      | cons b t =>
        have ht : t ∈ allBoolLists n := (ih t).mpr (by simpa using h)
        simp only [allBoolLists, List.mem_append, List.mem_map]
        cases b
        · right; exact ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
        · left; exact ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩

theorem foldr_max_ge (f : List Bool → Nat) :
    ∀ (L : List (List Bool)) (s : List Bool), s ∈ L →
      f s ≤ L.foldr (fun s acc => max (f s) acc) 0 := by
  intro L
  induction L with
  | nil => intro s hs; simp at hs
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro s hs
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hs with h | h
    · subst h
      simp only [List.foldr_cons]
      exact le_max_left _ _
    · simp only [List.foldr_cons]
      exact le_trans (ih s h) (le_max_right _ _)

theorem foldr_max_mem (f : List Bool → Nat) :
    ∀ (L : List (List Bool)),
      L.foldr (fun s acc => max (f s) acc) 0 = 0 ∨
        ∃ s ∈ L, L.foldr (fun s acc => max (f s) acc) 0 = f s := by
  intro L
  induction L with
  | nil => left; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    simp only [List.foldr_cons]
    rcases le_total (t.foldr (fun s acc => max (f s) acc) 0) (f a) with h | h
    · right
      exact ⟨a, by simp, max_eq_left h⟩
    · rw [max_eq_right h]
      rcases ih with h0 | ⟨s, hs, he⟩
      · left; exact h0
      · right; exact ⟨s, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hs, he⟩
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem knapsack_01_postcond_satisfied (weights values : List Nat) (capacity : Nat)
    (h_precond : knapsack_01_precond weights values capacity) :
    knapsack_01_postcond weights values capacity (knapsack_01 weights values capacity h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  unfold knapsack_01_postcond knapsack_01
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro selected hval
    unfold is_valid_strategy at hval
    obtain ⟨hlen, hw⟩ := hval
    have hmem : selected ∈ (allBoolLists weights.length).filter
        (fun s => decide (total_weight s weights ≤ capacity)) := by
      rw [List.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨(mem_allBoolLists _ _).mpr hlen, by simpa using hw⟩
    exact foldr_max_ge (fun s => total_value s values) _ selected hmem
  · rcases foldr_max_mem (fun s => total_value s values)
      ((allBoolLists weights.length).filter
        (fun s => decide (total_weight s weights ≤ capacity))) with h0 | ⟨s, hs, he⟩
    · refine ⟨List.replicate weights.length false, ?_, ?_⟩
      · unfold is_valid_strategy
        refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
        rw [total_weight_replicate_false]
        exact Nat.zero_le _
      · rw [total_value_replicate_false]
        exact h0.symm
    · have hs' := List.mem_filter.mp hs
      refine ⟨s, ?_, he.symm⟩
      unfold is_valid_strategy
      exact ⟨(mem_allBoolLists _ _).mp hs'.1, by simpa using hs'.2⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof

**Approach.** Since the item count `n = weights.length` is finite, a *brute-force* implementation is easiest to verify: enumerate all boolean lists of length `n`, keep those whose total weight is `≤ capacity`, and take the maximum of their values (`foldr max 0`).

theorem tw_cons (b : Bool) (bs : List Bool) (w : Nat) (ws : List Nat) :
    total_weight (b :: bs) (w :: ws) = (if b then w else 0) + total_weight bs ws := rfl

theorem tv_cons (b : Bool) (bs : List Bool) (v : Nat) (vs : List Nat) :
    total_value (b :: bs) (v :: vs) = (if b then v else 0) + total_value bs vs := rfl

theorem total_weight_replicate_false (n : Nat) (weights : List Nat) :
    total_weight (List.replicate n false) weights = 0 := by
  induction n generalizing weights with
  | zero =>
    rw [List.replicate_zero, tw_nil]
  | succ n ih =>
    cases weights with
    | nil => exact tw_right_nil _
    | cons w ws =>
      rw [List.replicate_succ, tw_cons]
      simp [ih]

theorem total_value_replicate_false (n : Nat) (values : List Nat) :
    total_value (List.replicate n false) values = 0 := by
  induction n generalizing values with
  | zero =>
    rw [List.replicate_zero, tv_nil]
  | succ n ih =>
    cases values with
    | nil => exact tv_right_nil _
    | cons v vs =>
      rw [List.replicate_succ, tv_cons]
      simp [ih]

theorem mem_allBoolLists : ∀ (n : Nat) (l : List Bool), l ∈ allBoolLists n ↔ l.length = n := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro l
    cases l with
    | nil => simp [allBoolLists]
    | cons b t => simp [allBoolLists]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro l
    constructor
    · intro h
      simp only [allBoolLists, List.mem_append, List.mem_map] at h
      rcases h with ⟨a, ha, hEq⟩ | ⟨a, ha, hEq⟩ <;>
        · subst hEq
          simp [(ih a).mp ha]
    · intro h
      cases l with
      | nil => simp at h
      | cons b t =>
        have ht : t ∈ allBoolLists n := (ih t).mpr (by simpa using h)
        simp only [allBoolLists, List.mem_append, List.mem_map]
        cases b
        · right; exact ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
        · left; exact ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩

theorem foldr_max_ge (f : List Bool → Nat) :
    ∀ (L : List (List Bool)) (s : List Bool), s ∈ L →
      f s ≤ L.foldr (fun s acc => max (f s) acc) 0 := by
  intro L
  induction L with
  | nil => intro s hs; simp at hs
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro s hs
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hs with h | h
    · subst h
      simp only [List.foldr_cons]
      exact le_max_left _ _
    · simp only [List.foldr_cons]
      exact le_trans (ih s h) (le_max_right _ _)

theorem foldr_max_mem (f : List Bool → Nat) :
    ∀ (L : List (List Bool)),
      L.foldr (fun s acc => max (f s) acc) 0 = 0 ∨
        ∃ s ∈ L, L.foldr (fun s acc => max (f s) acc) 0 = f s := by
  intro L
  induction L with
  | nil => left; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    simp only [List.foldr_cons]
    rcases le_total (t.foldr (fun s acc => max (f s) acc) 0) (f a) with h | h
    · right
      exact ⟨a, by simp, max_eq_left h⟩
    · rw [max_eq_right h]
      rcases ih with h0 | ⟨s, hs, he⟩
      · left; exact h0
      · right; exact ⟨s, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hs, he⟩
